name: Degotho's Projects
flavor: Degotho (and his Artisan: Tairok) are working on the following projects.

projects.name: Deadweight
projects.description: A humanoid femur coated in lead that feels impossibly heavy for its size.
item_prerequisite: One bar of lead laced with starmetal
notes: While holding Deadweight, the wielder falls twice as fast.
The wielder takes +1 damage per square fallen, up to 75 total damage.
If the wielder falls 5 or more squares, they can make a melee free strike during the fall.

projects.name: Tempest I
projects.description: Infusing armor with the essence of a storm.
item_prerequisite: A strip of starmetal struck by lightning
notes: As a maneuver, the armor is infused with storm essence.
The first adjacent creature to damage the wearer before the end of the next turn takes lightning damage equal to the highest characteristic score.
The triggering creature can be pushed 1 square.
Tairok can contribute project rolls during downtime.
